introduction: 211 Illinois offers free, confidential referrals to local assistance providers. Call 211, text your ZIP code to 898211 or search the statewide directory.
description: 211 Illinois offers free, confidential referrals to local assistance providers. Call 211, text your ZIP code to 898211 or search the statewide directory.

sections.who: Illinois residents can contact 211 for resource information. The service advertises round-the-clock access. Providers reached through a referral have separate intake and eligibility rules.
sections.get: Specialists help locate food, housing, utility, health and other services. The statewide directory is also searchable online.
sections.docs:
• Your location or ZIP code.
  • The service needed and any urgent deadline.
  • A way to record provider contact details.
sections.apply:
1. Contact 211

    Call 211 or text your ZIP code to 898211.

  2. Search directly

    Use Search For Help if you prefer browsing.

  3. Follow up with the provider

    Ask about intake, documents and availability before traveling.
sections.after: Return to 211 if a provider cannot help. Explain the result so the next referral can account for it.
sections.sources: Reviewed October 1, 2026 using 211 Illinois contact methods. Agency staff determine eligibility.

faqs: Is the administrative number the help line?
Use 211 for assistance referrals; the website labels its administrative office separately.
Can I ask about help outside Illinois?
The website links to Find Another 211 for other areas.
Will a referral pay my bill?
No. The provider assesses whether assistance can be offered.
Can I search without making a call?
Yes. Use the statewide online directory.
